title: fix: stop counting out-of-Pollen rejections as active users
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
A `402` means the caller had no Pollen left: the request is rejected at the balance check, before any provider runs. It is billed nothing and generates nothing — but it carries a `user_id`, so it counted as an active user and as a request. Last week that was 3.1M requests from 3,507 users.

**The effect was not cosmetic.** Reported WAU has been flat for ten weeks — 6,798 → 6,859 — while users who actually got a response fell 5,716 → 3,352. The dashboard showed a stable user base through a 41% decline.

| Metric (wk of 08-10) | Was | Now | |
|---|---|---|---|
| WAU | 6,859 | 3,352 | −51% |
| Total requests | 7,089,351 | 4,000,906 | −44% |
| Text requests | 0 *(bug)* | 3,291,498 | — |
| Image requests | 0 *(bug)* | 3,592,400 | — |
| Tokens/user | 239,530 | 490,135 | +105% |
| Community · users | 15.8% | 24.9% | +58% |
| BYOP user % | 15.0% | 11.1% | −26% |

Unchanged: tokens, paying users, Pollen revenue, cost, gross margin, cash coverage, availability, community request %/availability, registrations, activations.

- WAU and BYOP user % **cycle** to the raw figure, so nothing is lost.
- New **Turned away** row — users whose every request hit the Pollen wall.
- Per-user metrics (Tokens/user, ARPA, Purchase rate) divide by served WAU.
- Fixes `text_requests`/`image_requests`, which matched `event_type = 'text'` where the values are `generate.text` — both had always returned 0.

Pipe changes are additive. Only consumer is this dashboard (verified: no other `.pipe` references them, no other code reads them).

**Deploy order matters:** Tinybird must be promoted before this merges, or WAU renders blank. Deployments are built and ready — prod **167**, staging **96** — not promoted.

gist.headline: The dashboard counts bees properly
gist.blurb: The KPI garden now separates visitors who received a response from those stopped at the Pollen gate. It also found the text and image request counters hiding behind the wrong event names.
gist.summary: Weekly KPI pipelines now exclude 402 out-of-Pollen rejections from served WAU and request totals, add a Turned away user row, and correctly count generate.text and image events.
gist.impact: The internal dashboard now reports 3,352 served weekly active users instead of 6,859 for the week of 08-10, while preserving raw WAU and making per-user usage metrics reflect users who received responses.
